When smog is hazardous (PM2.5 at or above 165 µg/m³), people with asthma should avoid outdoor activity entirely. [DOC-01]
- Increase indoor air filtration, using an air purifier where available, especially in bedrooms. [DOC-11, DOC-01]
- Keep rescue inhalers accessible and follow your physician’s individual asthma action plan. [DOC-11]
- Keep windows closed during peak pollution hours: 6 AM–10 AM and 6 PM–10 PM. [DOC-01]
- If going outside is unavoidable, wear an N95 or KN95 mask; cloth and surgical masks offer little protection against PM2.5. [DOC-01]
- Seek medical attention immediately for shortness of breath, chest tightness, or persistent coughing. [DOC-01]

Cloth masks provide only minimal protection against PM2.5 and should not be relied upon during hazardous days. Use a properly fitted N95 or KN95 mask, sealed around the nose and mouth, to filter PM2.5 effectively (DOC-12).

No—based on the current forecast, schools in Walled City should follow normal timing on 5 November 2026, not close or switch to half-days (DOC-03). Forecast PM2.5 is 158.7 µg/m³, which is unhealthy but not hazardous (DOC-01). This is a model forecast with a typical error of about 13 µg/m³ and cannot anticipate sudden one-day spikes. School decisions are made the evening before using the next-day local forecast, with parents notified by SMS by 7:00 PM (DOC-03). Children should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion in these unhealthy conditions (DOC-01).

Outdoor play should be limited rather than treated as fully safe: Gulberg’s forecast PM2.5 for tomorrow, 2026-10-29, is 128.9 µg/m³—unhealthy, but not hazardous. Children are a sensitive group, so reduce prolonged outdoor exertion, including long or strenuous play sessions (DOC-01). This is a model forecast with a typical error of about 13 µg/m³, and it cannot anticipate sudden one-day spikes.

For DHA on 2026-11-02, the forecast PM2.5 is 139.5 µg/m³—unhealthy, but not hazardous (DOC-01). Sensitive groups should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. This is a model forecast with a typical error of about 13 µg/m³, and it cannot anticipate sudden one-day spikes.

Bahria Town is forecast to have PM2.5 of 126.9 µg/m³ on Friday, 2026-10-30—unhealthy, but not hazardous under DOC-01. Sensitive groups should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion; the general public may continue normal outdoor activity with reasonable caution. This is a model forecast with a typical error of about 13 µg/m³, and it cannot anticipate sudden one-day spikes.

The odd-even vehicle restriction applies when forecast PM2.5 for Lahore is hazardous—165 µg/m³ or above—for two or more consecutive days, following a Transport Department press release, in areas covered by the current sensor network (DOC-05). Private vehicles with plates ending in odd digits may operate only on odd calendar dates, and those ending in even digits only on even dates. Ambulances, fire service vehicles, government emergency vehicles and public transport buses are exempt. The restriction is lifted once forecast PM2.5 falls below 165 µg/m³ for two consecutive days (DOC-05).

During a smog alert, when forecast PM2.5 reaches hazardous levels of 165 µg/m³ or above, brick kilns operating without approved emission-control technology must suspend operations (DOC-08). Industries must also report stack emissions data daily to the Department during smog alerts. These restrictions are lifted when forecast PM2.5 stays below 165 µg/m³ for two consecutive days.
No PM2.5 forecast is available for Islamabad tomorrow. This system covers only 15 named areas of Lahore; Islamabad is outside its supported scope (DOC-13).

No forecast is available for Model Town on 20 December 2026 because that date is outside the supported forecast window. Forecasts cover 29 October–7 November 2026 for 15 Lahore areas, including Model Town (DOC-13), so I cannot provide a PM2.5 estimate or determine whether the air will be hazardous that day.

Schools close fully when forecast PM2.5 is **250 µg/m³ or above**, under the current school closure policy (DOC-03). The decision is made the evening before, using the next-day forecast for the school’s area.

Under the 2023 regulations (DOC-02), schools closed only when PM2.5 exceeded 300 µg/m³ for two consecutive days; there was no provision for half-day closures. That policy was superseded by DOC-03, effective 2026-09-20. Under the current rule, schools close fully when forecast PM2.5 is 250 µg/m³ or above, and close by 12:00 PM when it is 165–249 µg/m³.

In the unofficial Community Smog Bulletin, residents recommend keeping a damp cloth near doors and windows to catch dust. They also suggest indoor plants such as money plant and areca palm, which the bulletin says can modestly help indoor air quality (DOC-07).

Ji, mojooda policy ke mutabiq bachon ko school bhej sakte hain: kal, 2026-10-29 ko Johar Town mein forecast PM2.5 142.2 µg/m³ hai, jo unhealthy hai magar hazardous nahi (DOC-01). Yeh 165 µg/m³ se neeche hai, is liye half-day ya bandish ki sharaait poori nahi hotin aur school normal timing par chalega (DOC-03). Bachon ki dair tak bahar ki sakht jismani sargarmi kam rakhein, khaas taur par agar unhein asthma ho (DOC-01). School ka faisla pichhli shaam hota hai; shaam 7:00 PM tak aane wala school SMS check karein (DOC-03). Yeh model forecast hai, jis ki aam ghalti taqreeban 13 µg/m³ hai aur jo achanak aik din mein pollution ke baray uchhaal ki peshgoi nahi kar sakta.

Smog mein bahar warzish karna PM2.5 ki satah par munhasir hai:
- PM2.5 agar 165 µg/m³ ya zyada ho (hazardous), to bahar sakht warzish na karein aur bahar ka waqt 30 minute se kam rakhein; bachay, hamila khawateen, buzurg aur asthma ya dil ke mareez bahar ki sargarmiyon se bilkul parhez karein (DOC-01, DOC-04).
- PM2.5 agar 100–164 µg/m³ ho, to aam log munasib ehtiyat ke saath mamool ki bahar ki sargarmiyan kar sakte hain, lekin hassas afrad lambi der ki jismani mehnat kam karein (DOC-01).
- PM2.5 agar 100 µg/m³ se kam ho, to aam logon ke liye khaas ehtiyat zaroori nahin (DOC-01).
Is sawal ke saath maqami PM2.5 ya forecast nahin diya gaya, is liye abhi bahar warzish ko mehfooz qarar nahin diya ja sakta.
